children: Air Industries Group extended the maturity of its revolving credit and term loans to April 30, 2027, paying a $50,000 amendment fee and agreeing to pay another $50,000 at maturity. The company also extended convertible and nonconvertible subordinated notes held by Michael Taglich and Robert Taglich to May 1, 2027. If the contemplated merger does not occur by November 30, 2026, the related-party notes will carry a 2% principal increase and higher interest rates, while the convertible notes' conversion prices remain unchanged.
